merchant/30558.htm.text: Trader Jakal: Hail the eternal glory of the Flame! How are you, friend? What do you need? Please take a look! Nothing is worthless in my shop. And there is nothing that I cannot get for you! It's an old truth, that adventure requires preparation to succeed. Even we Orcs would do well to heed the an…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30558-1.htm.text: Trader Jakal: What are you looking for, my friend?

merchant/30558-pk.htm.text: Trader Jakal: I see you are well endowed with courage, ha ha ha! I like you. I really do like you. But, sweetie, do you know what you've gotten yourself into? You better go away before I get very upset!

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30558-01.html.text: Trader Jakal: Ah, you mean the Neruga Axe Blade? Yes, 1,000 Adena. No need to be surprised. You didn't think that I would give it to you for free, did you? No way! I am a merchant. It's a reasonable price for such precious symbol of the Neruga tribe spirit. If you don't agree, then leave!
when: state STARTED; has items 3391,3393; lacks items 3406,3405; item 57 >= 1000

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30558-04.html.text: Trader Jakal: The axe blade that I gave you is a part of the Neruga axe. It is a holy weapon which is used during a ceremony in the Pa'agrio Temple, so handle it with care!
when: state STARTED; has items 3391,3393,3405; lacks items 3406; !(hasQuestItems(player, ORDEAL_NECKLACE, TANTUS_CHARM) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, AXE_OF_CEREMONY, NERUGA_AXE_BL

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30558-05.html.text: Trader Jakal: That is our tribe's holy axe! That means you are someone acknowledged by Tantus, our Neruga tribe leader! Tejakar Oroka! I wish you endless glory in your future!
when: state STARTED; has items 3391,3406; lacks items 3393; !(hasQuestItems(player, ORDEAL_NECKLACE, TANTUS_CHARM) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, AXE_OF_CEREMONY, NERUGA_AXE_BL; !(hasQuestItems(player, ORDEAL_NECKLACE, TANTUS_CHARM, NERUGA_AXE_BLADE) && !hasQuestItems(player, AXE_OF_CEREMONY))

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30558-02.html.text: Trader Jakal: Very well! 1,000 Adena, exactly! Then here is the axe blade. This is one part of the axe which the Nerugas use in their ceremony. Handle it with care!

Q00232_TestOfTheLord/30558-03a.html.text: Trader Jakal: This is not enough money! Who do you think I am? If you ever try to buy something without enough money again, I will throw you out of the shop!
